title: Missile lock
description: The player's missile control (RULES C.7.1, C.7.2, C.7.4). The state is the cockpit's MissileLock; its transitions are made by the combat capability's missile functions, which the flight tick calls, and by Cockpit::reset.

states.description: armed false, target None: no missile armed.
armed true, target None: searching for a target in the active mount's sights.
armed false, target Some(slot): locked on the object in that slot.

transitions.trigger: try_lock in the slot loop's sights step
transitions.guard: the object is in the active mount's sights (deliberate difference 8) and the space view shows

transitions.action: The missile is added aimed at the target, the target becomes angry, one missile is used.
The jammed message; the lock is kept.

transitions.trigger: the locked object leaves the bubble (fix_up_lock)
an earlier slot's object leaves the bubble (fix_up_lock)
transitions.action: The lock moves down one slot.

transitions.trigger: Cockpit::reset: the start from the title, the launch, an arrival, docking, the escape-pod rescue, death and quitting to the title
Cockpit::reset: the start from the title, the launch, an arrival, docking, the escape-pod rescue, death and quitting to the title
